notes.title: WINDY WEDNESDAY RACING - 7PM CST EVERY WEEK
notes.notes:
🌊⛵ Awesome Sailing in [b]Multiplayer[/b] Today!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323982/409ba62eb90325edebfde3f1720fb3dbe25755ec.png[/img]

It’s great to see our community growing. Although our live multiplayer group remains intimate, it represents just the tip of the iceberg. I'm thrilled to see our fleet growing as we sail towards becoming the world's largest virtual sailing club.

🕕 Join us next time—Sunday at 6 PM Central.
Don’t miss the chance to be part of something bigger and experience the best of virtual sailing with real enthusiasts from around the globe.

[b]Events calendar:[/b] [url=https://lu.ma/vr-sailing]https://lu.ma/vr-sailing[/url]

[h1]Top 5 tips[/h1]

If you are new to VR Sailing, watch: [url=https://www.facebook.com/reel/850667043158935]https://www.facebook.com/reel/850667043158935[/url]

Here are the top 5 tips to master MarineVerse Cup and climb the leaderboards!

Think VR sailing is too challenging? Think again! With these tips, you'll be sailing like a pro in no time!

[h2]Tip 1: Master the Basics.[/h2]

Start with the tutorials. Learn the controls and get a grip on wind dynamics. These basics are crucial for your success!

[h2]Tip 2: Use Ghost Mode.[/h2]
Replay your previous races in Ghost Mode. Watch how top players navigate the course and try to beat their time!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323982/c32e69b74354d2f5a0b32f5d9d90d4ec79cfa647.png[/img]

[h2]Tip 3: Participate in Daily Practice Races.[/h2]
Join the daily practice races. In this ghost racing mode you will experience different wind conditions and courses - improve your adaptability and racing skills.

[h2]Tip 4: Engage with the Community.[/h2]
Join the MarineVerse Discord. Discuss strategies, share tips, and learn from other experienced sailors.

[h2]Tip 5: Join Multiplayer Events[/h2]
Once you've gotten your feet wet Daily Practice Races, it's time to jump into Fun Multiplayer  Racing!  [b]Every Sunday at 6 PM and Wednesday at 7 PM Central Time[/b], race with other players, hone your skills, and enjoy the thrill of competition.

[h1]Summary[/h1]

By following these tips, you’ll see a significant improvement in your VR sailing skills and start climbing those leaderboards!

Imagine the thrill of crossing the finish line first and seeing your name at the top of the leaderboard – it’s exhilarating!

Ready to take your VR sailing to the next level? 

Dive into MarineVerse Cup and start your journey to the top!

notes.title: MarineVerse Cup Steam Deck compatibility
notes.notes:
Ahoy sailors!

Are there any Steam Deck owners among us?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323982/0fff3c7a83a64fef055ba8fa2d912aebae8c5545.jpg[/img]

We've embarked on the journey of bringing MarineVerse Cup to the Steam Deck.

Currently, you can fully steer and control the boats using a gamepad, providing a relaxing, educational, and competitive racing experience.

The Main Menu does still require touch input, but rest assured, we're steering towards enhancing this for a smoother sail.

[b]For the best experience on your Steam Deck, we suggest selecting the "FPS" binding scheme. This can be done by navigating to Main Menu -> Settings -> Input -> Gamepad Bindings. Additionally, enable the gyroscope for more intuitive camera control.[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323982/9956126b7c471ec3abde7dfb5bdbb96bd7bc1b96.png[/img]

We're dedicated to refining gamepad integration and eagerly await your input. Your feedback on control preferences and any compatibility or usability issues is invaluable to us.

Embark on a voyage of virtual sailing with MarineVerse Cup, now more accessible than ever on the Steam Deck. We're all ears for your feedback – happy sailing!

The MarineVerse Team

notes.title: How to Sail Upwind?
notes.notes:
[previewyoutube=ppTIrmMG-gU;full][/previewyoutube]

While sailboats can sail upwind, they cannot sail directly into the wind. Presuming you want to sail to a point (perhaps a dock) directly upwind from you, instead you must sail a 'zig-zag' course to get there.

In this short video, we will learn how to get to a target that is directly upwind.

In MarineVerse Cup - you can complete this and other sailing lessons in virtual reality.

MarineVerse Cup is a competitive VR sailing game that wants to bring multiplayer yacht racing to every VR headset owner.

We're creating MarineVerse Cup for both gamers who enjoy advanced simulations, and sailors who want to sharpen their racing skills off the water. The game itself is a product of years of research, development, design, and testing.

The Cup offers daily and weekly races, with varying wind conditions and courses that will test your sailing and racing skills. You will battle your way up the racing leaderboards and make friends along the way as you compete for the monthly MarineVerse Cup.

As MarineVerse we are committed to democratizing sailing. MarineVerse Cup has been designed for the latest generation of standalone VR headsets like Oculus Quest, making it easy for a casual sailor to get into virtual reality sailing.

With today’s release we're putting an early access build of the game into the your hands. We're looking for [url=https://feedback.marineverse.com/marineverse-cup]community feedback[/url] and involvement to deliver a fun and authentic VR sailing experience. 

We're looking forward to meeting everyone on the water!
